messages:
Maya L.: flagging a follow-up on the spend UI review. two things from usability: users want a compact/dense toggle for lists, and they wanted a quicker way to preview invoice contents without downloading.

Josh K.: compact vs dense toggle makes sense. compact = one-line rows, dense = two-line with sparkline. we should default to compact on small viewports.

Elaine (Design): mock added: https://redwood.design/figma/spend-compact-dense 1 — variant A: compact + inline invoice preview slide-over; variant B: dense + preview modal.

Samir: accessibility: slide-over is ok but ensure focus trap and announce "Invoice preview for <scope>". modals need role=dialog and accessible name.

Oliver P.: product: preview should show header rows (date, total, token counts) and let user pick CSV columns before download. also add a small "open in new tab" link for large exports.

Elaine (Design): updated visual: preview slide-over with column checkboxes, "Download PDF" and "Export CSV" buttons. included keyboard shortcuts in mock: `D` for download PDF, `E` for export CSV.

Maya L.: file-naming rule we agreed before — keep it stable: `org[-project]_<YYYY-MM-DD>_<preset>.pdf` — ensure filename is set via Content-Disposition.

Samir: add to accessibility spec: when download starts, announce "Preparing invoice for download" and then provide a toast with link. screen-reader users often miss the file browser popup.

Josh K.: impl note: server will accept a `columns` array in POST and return a streaming CSV. will add telemetry: invoice_prepare, invoice_downloaded, preset_used.

Elaine (Design): microcopy: CTA in header = "Download invoices" (scoped) and preview action = "Preview invoice". also a small "CSV columns" helper inline.

Oliver P.: placement: prefer header CTA + preview action next to it. if viewport < 480px fallback to sticky bottom bar with primary download. A/B idea: header + preview vs bottom sticky only.

Samir: experiment metrics: download_rate, preview_open_rate, time_to_download, kb_per_download. ensure tab order lands on preview before other actions.

design-bot: attachment: preview-prototype-2123456789.png (uploaded)

Maya L.: timeline: can we get Figma frames and a small prototype by end of sprint? Josh, can you open RFC for API + filename behavior?

Josh K.: yep, I'll open RFC and stub endpoints. will include Content-Disposition example in RFC: `Content-Disposition: attachment; filename="AcmeCorp-Phoenix_2026-03-01_monthly.pdf"`.

Elaine (Design): I'll add focus states and aria labels in the handoff. tagging @eng-frontend and @research for experiment design.

Maya L.: great — will close after PR + Figma link are in the ticket.
